target.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts (AI-assisted)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Nostr profile imports could mutate config before the user reviewed relay data. To reproduce in the Control UI, edit a profile, click **Import from Relays**, change a field while the request is pending, then let the response complete: the imported value can overwrite the same-field edit. Click **Cancel** while the request is pending: the form closes, but the server-side merge can still persist.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Control UI now requests `autoMerge: false`, treats the relay response as a draft, locks profile controls while the import is pending, and owns an `AbortController` for the request. Cancel, disconnect, and form replacement abort and invalidate the operation, so a late response cannot update a hidden or newer form. Explicit **Save & Publish** remains the write path.

The existing HTTP contract is preserved: callers that explicitly send `autoMerge: true` still receive the server-side merge and persistence behavior. Only the Control UI opts into draft mode.

## User Impact

Imported values fill the open form for review. Users can edit them and explicitly publish, while Cancel cannot hide a mutation that already persisted and stale responses cannot replace a newer form. Existing API callers using `autoMerge: true` retain their prior behavior.

## Evidence

- Live relay and HTTP proof (redacted, 2026-07-13): an ephemeral kind:0 profile was published to `wss://relay.damus.io` and imported through the actual `createNostrProfileHttpHandler` in a real local `node:http` server. The draft request used `autoMerge:false`; the real client received `AbortError` after Cancel, the server completed afterward, and no config write occurred. The compatibility request used `autoMerge:true` and persisted the merged profile.

  ```json
  {
    "relay": "wss://relay.damus.io",
    "pubkeyPrefix": "8134dd8f…",
    "relayPublish": "accepted",
    "draftRequest": { "autoMerge": false },
    "draftClientResult": "AbortError",
    "draftCompletedAfterCancel": true,
    "draftPersistenceCalls": 0,
    "draftPersistedProfile": { "name": "local" },
    "legacyRequest": { "autoMerge": true },
    "legacyStatus": 200,
    "legacySaved": true,
    "legacyMergedName": "local",
    "legacyPersistenceCalls": 1
  }
  ```

- After rebasing onto current `origin/main` (`afb282ee682c`): `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/nostr/src/nostr-profile-http.test.ts extensions/nostr/src/nostr-profile-import.test.ts` — passed, 34 tests.
- After rebasing onto current `origin/main`: `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/channels/channels-page.test.ts ui/src/pages/channels/view.test.ts` — passed, 14 tests.
- After rebasing onto current `origin/main`: `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/e2e/nostr-profile-import.e2e.test.ts` — passed, 1 Playwright test.
- The first PR CI run exposed a type-only regression in the new test: `check-test-types` failed at `ui/src/pages/channels/channels-page.test.ts` because Vitest inferred zero-argument `mock.calls` tuples. The test now captures `RequestInit` inside a typed `vi.fn<typeof fetch>` callback.
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs` passed for the affected extension test project after the compatibility correction; the earlier full test-type run also passed for `tsconfig.core.test.json`, `tsconfig.extensions.test.json`, and `tsconfig.test.root.json`.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check`, type-aware `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --threads=1` over the changed files, and `git diff --check` passed before the final rebase.

## Limitations

The live proof uses a public relay and the actual HTTP handler in a real local HTTP runtime; it is not a remote deployed Control UI/Gateway recording. Sanitized AWS Crabbox warmup was unavailable before lease creation with `no EC2 IMDS role found`, and local Crabbox configuration has no broker token, so credential-hydrated Testbox was not used for fork code. GitHub CI for the new head is pending.
